senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to go to and back, cmp. זוּל, אֲזַל,] to spin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:6">Keth. VII, 6</cite> <he>טווָֹה בשוק</he> she spins in the street.
Tosef. Toh. IV, 11; Zeb. 79ᵇ פשתן שטְוָואֲתוֹ וכ׳ linen which a menstruant spun.—Part. pass. טָווּי.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:8">Kil. IX, 8</cite> <he>ט׳ או ארוג</he> spun or woven, v. <cite ref="U01650"><he>שַׁעַטְנֵז</he></cite>.
